hooks.name: Review Code File Writes
hooks.description: Review code file write operations for compliance with project standards. Excludes documentation, config, and test files.

action.prompt: Review this file write operation. ONLY review if the file path matches src/**/*.js (actual source code). SKIP and allow without review if the file is: documentation (*.md, docs/**), configuration (*.json, *.config.js, .env*, .kiro/**), or tests (tests/**, *.test.js). For source code files, verify they follow our API standards, error handling, security standards, and code style guidelines.
